Prealgebra · Lesson 4.8

Comparing Fractions

Solve this lesson →All lessons

Two climbers sit at 7997​ and 811118​ of the way up. Eight is more than seven, so the second climber looks ahead, but elevenths are thinner slivers than ninths, so that climber is stacking more pieces that are each smaller. Neither one obviously wins. This lesson gives you three ways to settle a comparison like that, rewriting over a common denominator, cross-multiplying, and leaning on landmarks like 1221​, along with a feel for which one is quickest on a given pair.

Problem
North crew: 5885​ of a path. East crew: 712127​. Rewrite over a common denominator, find which crew leads, then report the gap as a single fraction in simplest form.
Show a hint
  • A fraction only tells you "how many pieces" once you know the pieces are the same size. Eighths and twelfths are not, so find one denominator that both 88 and 1212 divide into and rewrite each fraction with it. The smallest one that works is 2424.
  • Scale each fraction to twenty-fourths. Multiply 5885​ by 3333​ to get 15242415​, and multiply 712127​ by 2222​ to get 14242414​. Now both are counts of the same twenty-fourths, so the bigger numerator is farther along. Subtract the smaller count from the larger to find the gap.
Show the full solution
Rewrite both over 2424. 58=5×38×3=152485​=8×35×3​=2415​ and 712=7×212×2=1424127​=12×27×2​=2414​, so the north crew leads with 1515 pieces to 1414. The gap is 1524−1424=1242415​−2414​=241​, already in simplest form. North is ahead by 1/241/24​ of the path. Comparing 55 against 77 directly does not work, since an eighth of the path and a twelfth of the path are different lengths.
Key idea
Compare by a common denominator. Two fractions are hard to compare when their pieces are different sizes. Rewrite both over a common denominator and every piece is the same size. Then the fraction with the bigger numerator is the larger one, and it sits farther right on the line. This is the same as counting twelve dimes and two quarters in cents before deciding which is more. The least common denominator keeps the numbers small, but any shared denominator works. This method is slower than the shortcuts ahead, and it works on every pair of fractions.
Problem
Compare 4774​ and 5885​ via the diagonal products 4×84×8 and 7×57×5. Which is larger, and what is the gap in simplest form?
Show a hint
  • The two tops are 4×8=324×8=32 and 7×5=357×5=35. The larger top wins, because both pieces are now measured in the same 5656ths. Which fraction does the bigger top belong to?
  • You have 32565632​ and 35565635​. The gap is just the difference of the tops over 5656, so compute 35−32565635−32​ and then reduce.
Show the full solution
Over the shared bottom 5656, 47=4×856=325674​=564×8​=5632​ and 58=7×556=355685​=567×5​=5635​. Since 35>3235>32, 5885​ is larger, and the gap is 3556−3256=3565635​−5632​=563​, already in simplest form. So the gap is 3/563/56​. Those two tops are exactly the diagonal products, which is why the diagonals settle the order without writing the common denominator at all.
Problem
Settle the wall: 7997​ vs 811118​. Compare 7×117×11 against 9×89×8. Which is higher, and by how much? Gap in simplest form.
Show a hint
  • Cross-multiplication sends each top across to the other bottom. Compare 7×117×11 with 9×89×8, and remember the bigger product belongs to the bigger fraction. That alone tells you which marker is higher.
  • Once you know 7997​ is higher, the gap is 79−81197​−118​. The common denominator is 9×11=999×11=99, so rewrite both fractions over 9999 and subtract the numerators. Then check whether the result can be reduced.
Show the full solution
Cross-multiply. 7×11=777×11=77 belongs to 7997​ and 9×8=729×8=72 belongs to 811118​, so 7997​ is higher. Those products are the numerators over 9×11=999×11=99, so the gap is 7799−7299=5999977​−9972​=995​. Since 99=9×1199=9×11 shares nothing with 55, that is simplest form. The left marker beats the right by 5/995/99​ of the route.
Key idea
Cross-multiplication for ordering. Compare abba​ and cddc​ over the shared denominator bdbd and the two numerators become a×da×d and b×cb×c. That denominator is the same for both, so it has no effect on which fraction is larger. You can skip writing it and compare only the two diagonal products. The bigger product belongs to the bigger fraction. These are the same diagonals as the equality test, where the two fractions are equal when ad=bcad=bc. This works only when both denominators are positive, so if a denominator is negative, move the minus sign to the numerator first.
Problem
611116​ vs 613136​: same tops. Elevenths are fatter than thirteenths, so six fat slices win. Find the gap in simplest form.
Show a hint
  • When two fractions share the same top, the one with the smaller bottom is the larger fraction, because the pieces being counted are bigger. So compare 611116​ and 613136​ by their bottoms alone, then subtract the smaller from the larger.
  • To subtract, rewrite both over the same bottom 11×13=14311×13=143. That turns 611116​ into 7814314378​ and 613136​ into 6614314366​. Now subtract the tops and check whether the result can be reduced.
Show the full solution
Both tops are 66, and an eleventh is a fatter piece than a thirteenth, so 611116​ is the larger share. For the gap use 11×13=14311×13=143, where 611=78143116​=14378​ and 613=66143136​=14366​, so 78143−66143=1214314378​−14366​=14312​, already in simplest form. The lead is 12/14312/143​. The denominators alone settled the direction, and the common bottom was only needed to measure the gap.
Problem
Blue 415154​, red 310103​. Match tops to 1212: 12454512​ vs 12404012​. Smaller bottom wins. Which share is larger, and by how much? Gap in simplest form.
Show a hint
  • You already have the matched-top forms 12454512​ and 12404012​. Same top, so smaller bottom wins. Which bottom is smaller, 4545 or 4040? That tells you the larger fraction. Once you know the order, the gap is just the larger fraction minus the smaller one.
  • The larger share is 310103​. To subtract 310−415103​−154​, find a common bottom for 1010 and 1515, which is 3030. Rewrite both as thirtieths, then subtract the tops. Simplify if you can.
Show the full solution
With the tops matched, 415=1245154​=4512​ and 310=1240103​=4012​. Both hold 1212 pieces, and cutting into 4040 parts makes bigger pieces than cutting into 4545, so the red ribbon 310103​ is the larger share. Over 3030, 310=930103​=309​ and 415=830154​=308​, so the gap is 930−830=130309​−308​=301​. Red leads by 1/301/30​ of a roll. With matched tops the smaller denominator wins, the reverse of the matched-bottom rule.
Problem
Tank 1: 8998​ (missing 1991​). Tank 2: 11121211​ (missing 112121​). Smaller gap means fuller. Which is fuller, and by how much? Simplest form.
Show a hint
  • The empty space in the first tank is 1991​, and in the second it is 112121​. With the same numerator of 1, the fraction with the bigger bottom number is the smaller piece. So which tank has less empty room, and is therefore fuller?
  • The fuller tank is the 11121211​ one, since 112121​ of emptiness is less than 1991​. The gap in fill levels is exactly the difference between the two empty pieces, 19−11291​−121​. Rewrite both over a common bottom of 36 and subtract.
Show the full solution
Each tank is one piece short of full, 1991​ for the first and 112121​ for the second. A twelfth is a thinner sliver than a ninth, so tank 2 has less empty room and 1112>891211​>98​. Both missing pieces are measured down from the same full mark, so the fill levels differ by 19−112=436−336=13691​−121​=364​−363​=361​. Tank 2 is fuller by 1/361/36​ of a tank.
Problem
Bars 13141413​ and 14151514​: gaps 114141​ and 115151​. Smaller gap is closer to done. Report the gap between the two bars in simplest form.
Show a hint
  • A bar is further along when the piece still left to fill is smaller. Compare the leftover pieces 114141​ and 115151​ first, since two unit fractions are easy to rank by their denominators.
  • The distance between the two bars is exactly the distance between their leftover pieces, because both bars are measured down from the same finish line. So compute 114−115141​−151​. Over a common denominator of 210210 that is 15210−1421021015​−21014​.
Show the full solution
The top bar has 114141​ left to fill and the bottom has 115151​. A fifteenth is the smaller piece, so the 14151514​ bar is closer to done. Both leftovers are measured down from the same finish line, so the distance between the bars is 114−115=15−1414×15=1210141​−151​=14×1515−14​=2101​. The bars are 1/2101/210​ apart. Subtracting the unit fractions this way makes the big denominator appear once, at the end, instead of at the start.
Key idea
Match the numerators. You do not have to match the denominators. You can match the numerators instead. Two fractions with the same numerator have the same number of pieces, so the one with the larger pieces is the larger fraction, and larger pieces mean a smaller denominator. That looks backwards until you check that an eleventh is a bigger piece than a thirteenth. The same idea works on fractions that are one piece short of a whole. Each is missing a single unit fraction, so compare those missing pieces, and the smaller missing piece belongs to the fraction closer to 11.
Problem
Six scores: 59,49,715,916,1120,81795​,94​,157​,169​,2011​,178​. Beat 1221​ when top >> half bottom. How many qualify?
Show a hint
  • Take one score at a time. For 5995​, half of the bottom 99 is 9229​, which sits between 44 and 55. Is the top, 55, bigger than that halfway mark? If yes, the score beats 1221​. Do the same quick check for the other five.
  • For an odd bottom like 99, 1515, or 1717, the top must reach at least the next whole number above half. Half of 99 is 412421​, so the top needs to be 55 or more. For an even bottom like 1616 or 2020, just double the top and compare to the bottom. Mark each score win or lose, then count the wins.
Show the full solution
A score beats 1221​ when its top is more than half its bottom. 5995​ wins since 5>4125>421​. 4994​ loses. 715157​ loses since 7<7127<721​. 916169​ wins since 9>89>8. 11202011​ wins since 11>1011>10. 817178​ loses since 8<8128<821​. That is 33​ qualifying scores. Half of a whole split into bb parts is b22b​ parts, so one comparison per score does the job with no common denominators.
Problem
Phone 1: 713137​. Phone 2: 920209​. Use 1221​ as landmark, confirm with cross-multiply. By how much is the more-charged phone ahead? Simplest form.
Show a hint
  • Twice 7 is 14, which clears 13, so 713137​ sits just above 1221​. Twice 9 is 18, which falls short of 20, so 920209​ sits just below 1221​. The one above half is the larger charge. For the exact gap you still need a common denominator.
  • The winner is 713137​. To subtract, put both over 13×20=26013×20=260. That turns 713137​ into 140260260140​ and 920209​ into 117260260117​. Subtract the tops and check whether the result reduces.
Show the full solution
Twice 77 is 1414, which clears 1313, so 713137​ sits above half. Twice 99 is 1818, short of 2020, so 920209​ sits below half. Phone 1 is the more charged one. Cross-multiplying agrees, 7×20=1407×20=140 against 9×13=1179×13=117, and those are the numerators over 13×20=26013×20=260, so the gap is 140260−117260=23260260140​−260117​=26023​. Since 2323 is prime and 260=22×5×13260=22×5×13, that is lowest terms. Phone 1 leads by 23/26023/260​.
Problem
Temperatures −35−53​ and −58−85​: both left of 00. Warmer is nearer 00. Which is the larger value, and how far apart are they? Positive fraction in simplest form.
Show a hint
  • Forget the signs for a moment and just compare the sizes 3553​ and 5885​. A common denominator of 4040 lets you stack them up. Whichever size is bigger is the morning that dipped deeper below the baseline, and a deeper dip means a value farther from 00.
  • Rewrite both sizes over 4040. You get 35=244053​=4024​ and 58=254085​=4025​, so 5885​ is the bigger size and −58−85​ is the deeper, more negative reading. The larger value is the shallower one, −35−53​. For the gap, subtract the two sizes, 2540−24404025​−4024​.
Show the full solution
Compare the sizes over 4040. 35=244053​=4024​ and 58=254085​=4025​, so −58−85​ dips deeper below 00 and −35−53​ is the larger, warmer value. The distance between the readings is the same as the distance between the sizes, 2540−2440=1404025​−4024​=401​, already in simplest form. The two mornings are 1/401/40​ of a degree apart. Below 00 the bigger size is the smaller value, so compare as positives and then flip the verdict.
Key idea
Landmarks and negatives. Before building a common denominator, check each fraction against an easy landmark like 1221​ or a whole 11. A fraction is greater than 1221​ when its numerator is more than half its denominator, and it equals 11 only when its numerator equals its denominator. If one fraction is above the landmark and the other is below, you have the answer right away. Negatives reverse the order. Each negative is the reflection of a positive across 00, so the negative closer to 00 is the larger value. The safe habit is to compare two negatives as if both were positive, then reverse the result.
Fun fact
Archimedes (c. 250 BC) trapped ππ between 2237171223​ and 227722​ with no decimals, needing to verify 22371<22771223​<722​, the same tools you used all chapter.
Problem
Three runners are near the finish. Mara is missing 1661​ of the course and Priya is missing 112121​, so settle those two by the smaller missing piece. Dev is at 7997​, so place him with a cross-multiply. Order all three, then report the gap between the leader and the runner in last, in simplest form.
Show a hint
  • Handle Mara and Priya with the missing piece first. Mara still has 1661​ of the course to go and Priya has only 112121​ to go. A smaller piece left means more finished, so one of them is clearly ahead of the other. For Dev, compare 7997​ against the others with a cross-multiply rather than guessing.
  • Compare Dev to Mara by cross-multiplying 7997​ and 5665​. You get 7×6=427×6=42 on Dev's side and 5×9=455×9=45 on Mara's side, so 79<5697​<65​. Together with the missing-piece result, the order from least to most is Dev, then Mara, then Priya. Now the gap you want is leader minus last, which is 1112−791211​−97​. Rewrite both over 3636 and subtract.
Show the full solution
Priya is 112121​ short of the finish and Mara is 1661​ short, and the smaller leftover means farther along, so Priya is ahead of Mara. For Dev, cross-multiply 7997​ against Mara's 5665​, giving 7×6=427×6=42 and 5×9=455×9=45, so Dev trails Mara and therefore Priya too. The order from least to most is Dev, Mara, Priya, so the gap from leader to last is 1112−79=3336−2836=5361211​−97​=3633​−3628​=365​, already in simplest form. That is 5/365/36​.
Problem
98999998​ misses 199991​, and 100101101100​ misses 11011011​. Smaller missing piece is larger rate. Which rate wins, and what is the gap in simplest form?
Show a hint
  • Forget the giant denominators for a second. Which missing piece is smaller, 199991​ or 11011011​? Fewer equal parts means bigger parts, so 199991​ is the larger gap. The rate that is missing the larger gap is further from 11, and the rate missing the smaller gap is the winner.
  • The two rates differ by exactly the difference between their missing pieces, 199−1101991​−1011​. Over the common denominator 99×101=999999×101=9999, that is 1019999−9999999999101​−999999​. Subtract the tops and check whether the result can be simplified.
Show the full solution
The rate 98999998​ is short by 199991​ and 100101101100​ is short by 11011011​. The bigger miss belongs to 98999998​, so 100101101100​ is the larger rate. The gap between the rates is the gap between the misses, 199−1101=1019999−999999=29999991​−1011​=9999101​−999999​=99992​, and 9999=9×11×1019999=9×11×101 is odd, so that is lowest terms. The rates differ by 2/99992/9999​.

Practice these ideas

Practice
Rosa: 3443​ of her wall. Ben: 5775​ of his. Find the common denominator, compare, give the gap as a fraction in simplest form.
Show the solution
Since 44 and 77 share no factor, the shared denominator is 4×7=284×7=28. Rosa has 34=212843​=2821​ and Ben has 57=202875​=2820​, so Rosa has painted more, and the gap is 2128−2028=1282821​−2820​=281​, already in simplest form. Rosa leads by 1/281/28​ of a wall.
Practice
Compare 811118​ and 710107​ by cross-multiplying. Which is larger, and how much greater is it? Report the gap as a fraction in simplest form.
Show the solution
The diagonal products are 8×10=808×10=80 for 811118​ and 11×7=7711×7=77 for 710107​, so 811118​ is larger. Those same products are the numerators over 11×10=11011×10=110, so the gap is 80110−77110=311011080​−11077​=1103​, already in simplest form. The larger beats the smaller by 3/1103/110​.
Practice
Find kk so that 6k=1520k6​=2015​. Set diagonal products equal: 6×20=k×156×20=k×15. What is kk?
Show the solution
Set the diagonal products equal, 6×20=k×156×20=k×15, so 120=15k120=15k and k=120÷15=8k=120÷15=8​. Quick check, 6886​ and 15202015​ both reduce to 3443​.
Practice
Compare 815158​ and 813138​: same numerator, different denominators. Which is larger? Report how much more that person has as a fraction in simplest form.
Show the solution
Both tops are 88, and thirteenths are bigger pieces than fifteenths, so 813>815138​>158​ and the person with the 13-strand ribbon has more. Over 15×13=19515×13=195, 813=120195138​=195120​ and 815=104195158​=195104​, so the gap is 120195−104195=16195195120​−195104​=19516​. Since 16=2×2×2×216=2×2×2×2 and 195=3×5×13195=3×5×13, that is already in simplest form, so the gap is 16/19516/195​.
Practice
635356​ and 940409​ each rewritten with numerator 1818: 1810510518​ vs 18808018​. Smaller bottom wins. Gap between them in simplest form?
Show the solution
Both matched forms have a top of 1818, and 8080 parts are bigger than 105105 parts, so 1880>181058018​>10518​ and the second recipe, 940409​, uses more. Both 4040 and 3535 divide 280280, so 940=63280409​=28063​ and 635=48280356​=28048​, and the gap is 63280−48280=15280=35628063​−28048​=28015​=563​ after cancelling a 55. The second recipe uses 3/563/56​ more of the jar.
Practice
Scores: 712127​, 511115​, 10191910​, 613136​, 917179​. Beat 1221​ when top >> half the bottom. How many exceed 1221​?
Show the solution
Double the top and compare it with the bottom. 712127​ gives 14>1214>12, a win. 511115​ gives 10<1110<11, a loss. 10191910​ gives 20>1920>19, a win. 613136​ gives 12<1312<13, a loss. 917179​ gives 18>1718>17, a win. That is 33​ scores above 1221​. Doubling works because 1221​ is exactly the case where the top equals half the bottom.
Practice
Green trail checkpoint: 815158​. Orange: 716167​. Use 1221​ as a landmark to decide which is farther, then find the gap. Give your answer as a fraction in simplest form.
Show the solution
Twice 88 is 1616, which clears 1515, so 815>12158​>21​. Twice 77 is 1414, short of 1616, so 716<12167​<21​. Green is the farther checkpoint. For the gap use 15×16=24015×16=240, where 815=128240158​=240128​ and 716=105240167​=240105​, so 128240−105240=23240240128​−240105​=24023​. Since 2323 is prime and does not divide 240240, the gap is 23/24023/240​.
Practice
Cup 1: 910109​ full (gap 110101​). Cup 2: 10111110​ full (gap 111111​). Smaller gap means fuller. Find the gap between fill levels in simplest form.
Show the solution
Cup 1 leaves 110101​ empty and cup 2 leaves 111111​. The bigger bottom makes the smaller piece, so cup 2 has less empty space and 10111110​ is the fuller one. Both gaps are measured down from the same brim, so the levels differ by 110−111=11110−10110=1110101​−111​=11011​−11010​=1101​. The two levels are 1/1101/110​ of a cup apart.
Practice
Survey 1: missing 150501​. Survey 2: missing 151511​. Smaller missing piece is further along. Gap between completion fractions in simplest form?
Show the solution
Survey 1 is 150501​ short of done and survey 2 is 151511​ short. A fifty-first is the smaller leftover, so survey 2 is further along. Both leftovers are measured from the same finished whole, so the completion fractions differ by 150−151=512550−502550=12550501​−511​=255051​−255050​=25501​, already in simplest form. Survey 2 leads by 1/25501/2550​.
Practice
Temperatures −59−95​ and −47−74​. Warmer is closer to 00. Which reading is warmer? Report how far apart the readings are as a positive fraction in simplest form.
Show the solution
Compare the sizes over 9×7=639×7=63. 59=356395​=6335​ and 47=366374​=6336​, so 4774​ is the bigger size, which puts −47−74​ farther below 00 and makes −59−95​ the warmer reading. The distance between them is the difference of the sizes, 3663−3563=1636336​−6335​=631​. The readings are 1/631/63​ apart.
Practice
Four sprinters: 712127​, 5885​, 11181811​, 2332​. Use the fastest comparison tool for each pair. Write the single largest fraction in its original form.
Show the solution
All four denominators divide 7272. Rewriting, 712=4272127​=7242​, 58=457285​=7245​, 1118=44721811​=7244​, and 23=487232​=7248​. The pieces are now the same size, so the biggest numerator wins. That is 4848, which came from 2/32/3​.
Practice
Sand: gains 3443​, loses 1331​. Find what remains, compare to 1221​. By how much does it differ from 1221​? Simplest form.
Show the solution
Over 1212, the leftover sand is 34−13=912−412=51243​−31​=129​−124​=125​ of a scoop. Half a scoop is 612126​, so what remains is a little less than half, short by 612−512=112126​−125​=121​. The sand misses the halfway mark by 1/121/12​ of a scoop.
Practice
Maya: 13161613​ of her goal. Theo: 17202017​. Both past halfway, so use cross-multiplication. By what fraction, in simplest form, is the leader ahead?
Show the solution
Both 1616 and 2020 divide 8080. Maya has 1316=65801613​=8065​ and Theo has 1720=68802017​=8068​, so Theo leads. The gap is 6880−6580=3808068​−8065​=803​, and since 80=2×2×2×2×580=2×2×2×2×5 has no factor of 33, that is already in simplest form. Theo is ahead by 3/803/80​.
Practice
Mosaic 1: 123124124123​ done (missing 11241241​). Mosaic 2: 199200200199​ (missing 12002001​). Smaller missing piece wins. Report the gap in simplest form.
Show the solution
Each mosaic is one tile from done, 11241241​ missing for the first and 12002001​ for the second. The bigger denominator makes the smaller hole, so mosaic 2 is the more complete one. The completions differ by the difference of the holes. Here 124=4×31124=4×31 and 200=8×25200=8×25 share only a factor of 44, so the least common denominator is 124×2004=62004124×200​=6200, and 1124−1200=506200−316200=1962001241​−2001​=620050​−620031​=620019​, lowest terms since 1919 is prime. Mosaic 2 leads by 19/620019/6200​.
